lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in an approximate grid posterior to the pectoral fin; observable nodes show increasing inter-blob spacing in the posterior-facing vector.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (~15-20 pixels width) intersecting with horizontal alignment vectors, with primary centroids positioned at these grid-like intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper visible flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light dorsal pixels to shadowed sub-ridge pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible left pectoral fin displays a high-density clustering of smaller high-luminance blobs compared to the wider spacing of the primary lateral flank constellation.
